panels.title: Q1': MONTHLY SALES VS HOSPITAL DEMAND BY REGION

targets.rawSql: WITH monthly_sales AS ( SELECT d.calendar_year, d.month_name, d.month_number, m.medicine_id, m.generic_name, m.disease_category, f.region, SUM(s.quantity_sold_packs) AS CommercialUnitsSold, SUM(s.net_sales_amount_usd) AS CommercialNetSalesUSD FROM gold.fact_pharm_sales s JOIN gold.dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key JOIN gold.dim_medicine m ON s.medicine_sk = m.medicine_sk JOIN gold.dim_facility f ON s.facility_sk = f.facility_sk GROUP BY d.calendar_year, d.month_name, d.month_number, m.medicine_id, m.generic_name, m.disease_category, f.region ), monthly_demand AS ( SELECT d.calendar_year, d.month_name, d.month_number, m.medicine_id, m.generic_name, m.disease_category, f.region, SUM(dem.requested_quantity_packs) AS TotalRequestedPacks, SUM(dem.consumed_quantity_packs) AS TotalConsumedPacks, SUM(dem.unfulfilled_demand_packs) AS TotalUnfulfilledPacks FROM gold.fact_demand dem JOIN gold.dim_date d ON dem.date_key = d.date_key JOIN gold.dim_medicine m ON dem.medicine_sk = m.medicine_sk JOIN gold.dim_facility f ON dem.facility_sk = f.facility_sk GROUP BY d.calendar_year, d.month_name, d.month_number, m.medicine_id, m.generic_name, m.disease_category, f.region ) SELECT COALESCE(s.calendar_year, dem.calendar_year) AS "Year", COALESCE(s.month_name, dem.month_name) AS "Month", COALESCE(s.generic_name, dem.generic_name) AS "Medicine", COALESCE(s.disease_category, dem.disease_category) AS "Disease", COALESCE(s.region, dem.region) AS "Region", COALESCE(s.CommercialUnitsSold, 0) AS "Units Sold", COALESCE(dem.TotalRequestedPacks, 0) AS "Requested", COALESCE(dem.TotalConsumedPacks, 0) AS "Consumed", COALESCE(dem.TotalUnfulfilledPacks, 0) AS "Unfulfilled", ROUND(COALESCE(dem.TotalConsumedPacks, 0)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(dem.TotalRequestedPacks, 0) * 100, 2) AS "Fill Rate %" FROM monthly_sales s FULL OUTER JOIN monthly_demand dem ON s.calendar_year = dem.calendar_year AND s.month_number = dem.month_number AND s.medicine_id = dem.medicine_id AND s.region = dem.region ORDER BY "Year" DESC, "Month" DESC, "Unfulfilled" DESC LIMIT 15;

panels.title: Q1' Monthly Sales vs Clinical Hospital Demand (Clean Natural Key Full Outer Join)

targets.rawSql: SELECT f.facility_type AS "Sales Channel", m.therapeutic_class AS "Therapeutic Class", COUNT(DISTINCT s.sales_transaction_id) AS "Orders", SUM(s.quantity_sold_packs) AS "Packs Sold", SUM(s.gross_sales_amount_usd) AS "Gross Sales USD", SUM(s.discount_amount_usd) AS "Discounts USD", ROUND(SUM(s.discount_amount_usd) / NULLIF(SUM(s.gross_sales_amount_usd), 0) * 100, 2) AS "Discount %", SUM(s.net_sales_amount_usd) AS "Net Sales USD", SUM(s.cost_of_goods_sold_usd) AS "COGS USD", SUM(s.gross_margin_usd) AS "Gross Margin USD", ROUND(SUM(s.gross_margin_usd) / NULLIF(SUM(s.net_sales_amount_usd), 0) * 100, 2) AS "Margin %", ROUND(SUM(s.days_to_expiry_at_sale * s.quantity_sold_packs)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM(s.quantity_sold_packs), 0), 1) AS "Pack-Weighted Shelf Life (Days)" FROM gold.fact_pharm_sales s JOIN gold.dim_medicine m ON s.medicine_sk = m.medicine_sk JOIN gold.dim_facility f ON s.facility_sk = f.facility_sk GROUP BY f.facility_type, m.therapeutic_class ORDER BY "Gross Margin USD" DESC LIMIT 12;
